description.text: The eighth expansion of the Sun & Moon series, released on 7 September 2018, with Lugia-GX on the wrapper; Lugia also appears in the 2018 film The Power of Us. With this set the Lost Zone, partly revived by Prism Star cards, returned in full for the first time since the LEGEND series: Lugia-GX's GX attack sends the opponent's Active Pokémon and all its cards there, and Blacephalon-GX puts Fire Energy there to do 50 damage for each. Most of the set's Pokémon come from the Johto region, with Tyranitar-GX, Suicune-GX and Shuckle-GX and Prism Star Celebi, Lusamine and Heat Factory. Packs held five cards. The cards are numbered to 95, followed by full-art Super Rare Pokémon-GX, Whitney, Professor Elm's Lecture and Faba, rainbow Hyper Rare Pokémon-GX, and gold Ultra Rare Wait and See Hammer, Lost Blender and Choice Helmet. In English many of its cards came out in Lost Thunder in November 2018.
